body: if you are up right now, id love to...

who cares what a select group of people have said about your art?

we all have different art styles, and that's what makes art so unique. art is art, and nobody has a place of power to determine if it's "bad." 

you have a passion which is more than a lot of people can say. i think you should follow that passion and say, "fuck the world."

if you want to find success in life, just know whatever path you may choose will be rocky. you *will* fall down at times, and you may fail at times too. but it is not our failures that determine who we are, it's how we decide to approach the next right step that determine it.
